extraFacts.fact: API 598 covers the inspection and testing of valves, including shell, backseat and seat tests; API 609 covers butterfly valves (lug, wafer and double-flanged types, Category A and Category B); API 600 covers bolted-bonnet steel gate valves; API 602 covers compact steel gate, globe and check valves of small bore; API 603 covers corrosion-resistant bolted-bonnet gate valves; API 6D covers pipeline valves; API 594 covers wafer, lug and flanged check valves; API 599 covers metal plug valves; API 607 is the fire test for valves with non-metallic seats; BS 1868 covers steel check valves and BS 1873 steel globe valves; ASME B16.34 covers valve pressure-temperature ratings and ASME B16.10 covers valve face-to-face lengths; EN 10204 3.1 is the inspection certificate type for material certificates; ISO 15848 covers fugitive emissions of valves.
extraFacts.source: API 598, API 609, API 600, API 602, API 603, API 6D, API 594, API 599, API 607; BS 1868; BS 1873; ASME B16.34; ASME B16.10; EN 10204; ISO 15848 (standard titles)

faqs.q: What is the rubber-lined concentric butterfly valve used for?
faqs.a: The rubber-lined concentric butterfly valve is a butterfly valve, concentric (rubber lined) built to API 609 Category A (to NPS 60), EN 593, used for water, cooling water, utilities, chemicals. It is made in NPS 2" to 72" (DN50 to DN1800) and Class 125/150, PN6 to PN16, and is built to order and supplied from Dubai; see the [butterfly valves](/c/industrial-butterfly-valves).

faqs.q: How do I read the rubber-lined concentric butterfly valve part numbers such as IH-PV-BFC-LG-150-1600?
faqs.a: In the size table IH-PV-BFC-LG-150-1600 is the 16" Lug valve in Class 150: the number before the size is the class, and the last four digits are the size in hundredths of an inch, and LG is "Lug". The table lists 60 size and class combinations.

faqs.q: What sizes and classes is the rubber-lined concentric butterfly valve available in?
faqs.a: The published range for the rubber-lined concentric butterfly valve is NPS 2" to 72" (DN50 to DN1800), in Class 125/150, PN6 to PN16. The size table lists 60 size and class combinations with lengths and weights, so you can check the valve against the piping layout.

faqs.q: What pressure and temperature can the rubber-lined concentric butterfly valve take?
faqs.a: The rubber-lined concentric butterfly valve is rated Class 125/150, PN6 to PN16 over a temperature range of -35 °C to 200 °C, depending on liner. The rating falls as temperature rises, so give the design pressure and temperature of the line and we confirm the class and material.

faqs.q: What materials is the rubber-lined concentric butterfly valve made in?
faqs.a: The body is available in ductile iron, carbon steel, stainless steel, bronze, with EPDM, NBR or FKM liner. The construction is Fully rubber-lined body, centred disc and stem.

faqs.q: What tests and documents come with the rubber-lined concentric butterfly valve?
faqs.a: Each rubber-lined concentric butterfly valve has shell and seat tests to API 598 (API 609), with the material certificates (EN 10204 3.1) and the pressure-test record supplied. Third-party inspection and extra tests are added when the order specifies them.

faqs.q: How is the rubber-lined concentric butterfly valve operated, and what end connections does it have?
faqs.a: The rubber-lined concentric butterfly valve has wafer, lug, double flanged ends and is operated by lever, gear operator, pneumatic, electric or hydraulic actuator. Say which operator and end connection you need, and give the pipe schedule for butt-weld ends.

faqs.q: rubber-lined concentric butterfly valve: Which liner should I choose?
faqs.a: EPDM for water, steam condensate and many acids and alkalis; NBR for oils and fuels; FKM (Viton) for hydrocarbons and higher temperatures. Send the fluid and temperature and we will confirm.

faqs.q: rubber-lined concentric butterfly valve: What pressure can a concentric valve hold?
faqs.a: These valves are rated Class 125/150 and PN6 to PN16. For higher pressures or hydrocarbons at temperature, use a double or triple offset valve.

faqs.q: How does the rubber-lined concentric butterfly valve compare with the API 609 double offset butterfly valve?
faqs.a: The rubber-lined concentric butterfly valve differs from the [API 609 double offset butterfly valve](/p/double-offset-butterfly-valve-api-609) in construction: fully rubber-lined body, centred disc and stem here, double offset disc, replaceable seat on the other. Also, standard: API 609 Category A (to NPS 60), EN 593 here, API 609 Category B to NPS 60; ASME B16.34 on the other. This valve is for water, cooling water, utilities, chemicals; the other is for process, hydrocarbons, cooling water, HVAC.

faqs.q: Where is the rubber-lined concentric butterfly valve supplied from?
faqs.a: The rubber-lined concentric butterfly valve is built to order to your specification and supplied from Dubai, UAE to projects, plants and maintenance teams across the GCC, the wider Middle East and Africa. Delivery depends on size, class, material and operator; standard carbon-steel sizes move fastest.

faqs.a: Yes. We keep the rubber-lined concentric butterfly valve in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Built-to-order specifications are quoted with their own delivery time. Send the part numbers and quantities through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.

faqs.q: What tests and documents come with the API 609 double offset butterfly valve?
